verdict.rationale: Zapier's core product is defining trigger-action automations ('Zaps'), documented extensively (Visual Builder, CLI, Platform for triggers/actions) and corroborated by independent community use of 'if this then that' style automations. Missing for 10: deeper native support for complex conditional/branching logic, which community reports (comm-3, comm-11, comm-13) note as a recurring limitation requiring workarounds.
